summary.text: Winston Jordan is a Get Money Out Party candidate for New Jersey's open 12th Congressional District, running what he calls a "no money, no donation" campaign that accepts no campaign contributions of any kind. An Army veteran and IT professional, he describes himself as a progressive advocating for a renewal of New Deal-era economic guarantees.

paragraphs.text: Winston Jordan was born in Brooklyn, New York, and WHYY reports he is 68 and lives in Hopewell Township, New Jersey.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1976 to 1978 and earned a military citation from Big Bend Community College in 1977.
Jordan has worked as a computer systems analyst, engineer and IT executive, according to WHYY; Ballotpedia also lists author among his career experience.
